summary: Frontend-only gallery polish regression run completed on public URL. Most requested behaviors pass (16-slide index present, object-position mapping desktop/mobile, team switch persistence, responsive overflow checks), but critical transition/stacking and keyboard determinism issues remain.

ui_bugs.issue: After selecting some slides, previous slide remains visibly rendered (e.g., rookie opacity ~0.45 while met-lace is active at ~800ms), violating single stable active slide expectation and causing visual ambiguity.
Keyboard determinism fails intermittently from requested slide context (Space/ArrowUp/PageDown/PageUp sequence from slide 03 not consistently producing expected target slide in runtime checks).
Control/copy overlap observed on specific slides (e.g., issue-credit overlapping controls; heading intersecting index rail).

integration_issues.issue: Flaky settle state observed once: active reached records but data-traveling remained true at check time; other runs settled correctly.

issues: Text/control overlap in some slides against index/control zones
Visible lingering previous slide during transitions reduces polish quality

action_items: Fix transition lifecycle so only one gallery-photo-* slide remains visibly active at stable state.
Re-validate keyboard path from exact slide 03 context (Space->04, ArrowUp->03, PageDown/ArrowDown/PageUp) after transition-layer fix.
Adjust per-slide heading/credit/index/control positions to remove overlap on failing slides.
Investigate framer-motion clipPath keyframe warnings; invalid keyframes likely contribute to unstable transition visuals.
critical_code_review_comments: AnimatePresence/motion state currently allows lingering visible previous slide nodes beyond intended transition window on some paths.
Console repeatedly logs 'Invalid keyframe value for property clipPath', indicating malformed or unsupported keyframe values during transitions.

Core positive checks: desktop/mobile object-position mapping from content.js matched expected values for all 16 slides; team switch preserved active slide; responsive matrix had no horizontal overflow in tested viewports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run fresh keyboard and transition checks after fixing layer/clipPath behavior. Avoid synthetic TouchEvent injection for pass/fail judgments; it can trigger tool-induced runtime errors unrelated to real user touch. Prefer physical swipe emulation path or device-level interaction.
rca of the issue: Primary RCA points to transition stack instability: previous and target slides coexist visibly longer than expected, likely compounded by invalid clipPath keyframe generation (console warnings). This destabilizes active-state perception and keyboard determinism assertions. Reproduction: open #route-gallery, jump to slide 03 via index, observe multiple gallery-photo-* nodes with non-trivial opacity after settle window and inconsistent key sequence outcomes.
